TestProcessPayment_ExpiredCard_PastYear       // Year < current
TestProcessPayment_ExpiredCard_PastMonth      // Same year, past month

// Rate Limiting
TestProcessPayment_RateLimitExceeded          // Limiter returns false

// Idempotency
